description: This file defines a final class 'UnmodifiableExternalMessageBuilder' which implements the 'ExternalMessageBuilder' interface. It provides methods to construct and configure instances of ExternalMessage, including setting headers, payloads, authorization, topic path, enforcement filters, header and payload mappings, source information, and internal headers. The class emphasizes immutability for ExternalMessage instances by using a builder pattern.

classes.name: UnmodifiableExternalMessageBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing immutable ExternalMessage instances, supporting configuration of headers, payloads, authorization, topic, enforcement, mappings, source, and internal headers.

methods.name: withAdditionalHeaders
methods.description: Adds a header key-value pair to the message.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Replaces the current headers with the provided header map.

methods.name: withText
methods.description: Sets the payload as a text string.

methods.name: withBytes
methods.description: Sets the payload as a byte array or ByteBuffer.

methods.name: withTextAndBytes
methods.description: Sets both text and byte payloads.

methods.name: withAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Associates an authorization context with the message.

methods.name: withTopicPath
methods.description: Associates a topic path with the message.

methods.name: withEnforcement
methods.description: Sets an enforcement filter for the message.

methods.name: asResponse
methods.description: Marks the message as a response.

methods.name: asError
methods.description: Marks the message as an error.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs an immutable ExternalMessage instance with the current configuration.
